subject: Medixis retention deviation request — 12 month logs & CAIQ evidence
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@medixis.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medixis.com, procurement@medixis.com
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 12m log retention carveout + CAIQ evidence

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this — Medixis has a compliance requirement to retain certain inference and audit logs for 12 months for a specific clinical workflow (patient-match and de-identification flows). Our baseline review of Redwood's standard TTL (90 days) flags a gap for that workload.

Can Redwood confirm whether we can: 
- Preserve tenant-scoped request & audit logs for a 12-month window for a designated tenant ID (Medixis-prod)
- Provide the CAIQ / SIG mappings and a SOC 2 artifact showing the retention policy and proof-of-delete for expired samples

We are prepared to sign a limited addendum if needed; procurement copied. For context, the log types are: request headers, inference trace (no patient PHI stored), and system audit trails. I attached a short request packet.

Attachments: Medixis_Retention_Request.pdf (request form)

Thanks,
Claire Jensen
Director of Security Engineering
Medixis Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@medixis.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T10:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 12m log retention carveout + CAIQ evidence

Claire — thanks for the clear ask and the packet. Looping in Marissa (security/compliance lead) and Priyom (platform engineering) to scope impact. Quick answers up front: we can support customer-scoped longer retention via a tenant-level policy and export options, but a few clarifying questions so we size the evidence bundle correctly: 

1) Confirm which specific log buckets you need to preserve (you listed three types — can you confirm file prefixes or example keys for Medixis-prod?)
2) Do you require Redwood to host the 12-month logs, or would Medixis accept a daily exported copy to your S3 with Confirmed Write + checksum retention?
3) Is a signed addendum acceptable operationally from your procurement team (procurement@medixis.com CC'd)?

What we will provide next: 
- A CAIQ export and SIG matrix scoped to the Terraform/runtime controls that govern log retention and deletion.
- SOC 2 evidence: retention policy excerpt and documented proof-of-delete workflows (sample audit) — we'll include a proof-of-delete run for a non-production tenant for verification.
- A retention_matrix_template.csv so you can annotate which logs matter most.

If you can reply with the prefixes and whether an exported-copy model is acceptable, we'll prepare a targeted evidence bundle by EOD tomorrow. Priyom — can your team confirm whether the tenant-level 12mo TTL is feasible today and any estimated cost delta? Marissa — can you draft the evidence list we'll surface to Claire?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@medixis.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medixis.com, procurement@medixis.com
Date: 2026-10-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 12m log retention carveout + CAIQ evidence

Ben — thanks, that approach works. Details below: 

- Prefixes: medixis-prod/requests/*, medixis-prod/inference-traces/*, medixis-prod/system-audit/*
- We prefer Redwood to retain the primary copy for 12 months under Medixis tenant policy; fallback export to our S3 is acceptable as a compensating control if you provide confirmed writes and daily export checksum manifests.
- Procurement: we'll review an addendum; initial expectation is a short operational SLA appendix.

Procurement contact: Laura Park <procurement@medixis.com> (same as CC).

Attached a draft SOW that shows the scope we anticipate — the addendum can be minimal if you can supply the evidence we asked for. Would you be able to include a sample proof-of-delete run and a CAIQ snippet that ties retention controls to specific Question IDs?

Attachments: medixis_sow_draft.docx

On Fri, Oct 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@medixis.com> wrote:
> Hi Ben,
> 
> Thanks for taking this — Medixis has a compliance requirement to retain certain inference and audit logs for 12 months for a specific clinical workflow (patient-match and de-identification flows). Our baseline review of Redwood's standard TTL (90 days) flags a gap for that workload.

Best,
Claire

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@medixis.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Park <procurement@medixis.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 12m log retention carveout + CAIQ evidence

Claire / team — follow-up after our internal alignment. Summary and proposed path forward: 

1) Technical approach (Priyom): Redwood can enable a tenant-scoped 12-month TTL for the specified prefixes (medixis-prod/*). Implementation options:
   - Option A (Redwood-hosted): Keep canonical logs on Redwood for 12 months; enable per-tenant lifecycle and snapshot-based cold storage (recommended for minimal operational lift).
   - Option B (Export + host): Daily export to Medixis S3 bucket with write-confirmation and SHA256 manifest (compensating control; Redwood hosts proofs and will run monthly verification).

2) Evidence bundle (Marissa): We'll assemble the CAIQ answers mapping to the retention-related question IDs, SOC 2 retention policy excerpt, and a sample proof-of-delete run (we will run the proof-of-delete on a sample non-prod tenant and provide logs, screenshots, and the deletion job ID). Expect the bundle in a single ZIP.

3) Timeline & commercials: Technical readiness check by 2026-10-20; evidence bundle delivery by 2026-10-21. If you choose Option A there will be a modest incremental cost to cover longer storage and snapshot retention — we'll provide an estimated delta once Priyom confirms storage sizing. Procurement Laura — if you can share the addendum template we will review and return redlines the same day.

Attachments: retention_matrix_template.csv (template for you to mark critical prefixes), proposed_evidence_bundle.zip (placeholder — final ZIP will be uploaded to our shared drive)

Quoted for context:
> On Oct 15, 2026, at 11:03 AM, Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@medixis.com> wrote:
> 
> > Prefixes: medixis-prod/requests/*, medixis-prod/inference-traces/*, medixis-prod/system-audit/*
> > We prefer Redwood to retain the primary copy for 12 months under Medixis tenant policy; fallback export to our S3 is acceptable as a compensating control if you provide confirmed writes and daily export checksum manifests.
> 
Next steps: Claire — confirm Option A vs Option B and whether you want Redwood to proceed with the non-prod proof-of-delete this week. Priyom — please confirm estimated cost delta and whether any change to rollout ETA is expected. Marissa — please compile the CAIQ mapping and SOC 2 excerpt; put the items in the shared drive link above.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
